The Role of Animal Breeding in Productivity Growth: Evidence from Wisconsin Dairy Farms
abstract: We examine the relationship between investments in animal breeding and productivity growth on Wisconsin dairy farms using a control function approach. We incorporate farm‐level annual investment in breeding and genetics into the law of motion of productivity as in De Loecker (2013) to test the relationship between these investments and realized productivity. Our unique dataset also allows us to look at the effect of choosing bulls with high milk yield potential on productivity. Our results indicate that breeding investments made 3 years prior are associated with higher productivity of the current cohort. However, the farms with the highest level of productivity reap the lowest benefits from breeding investments, suggesting that there are diminishing returns to investing in genetics. When milk output is not quality adjusted, the contribution of breeding to productivity is undetectable, suggesting that breeding and investments in milk quality are related. We conclude that investments in breeding and genetics significantly contribute to dairy farm productivity, especially in terms of milk quality.
abstract_zh: 我们利用控制函数方法，考察了威斯康星州奶牛场的动物育种投资与生产率增长之间的关系。我们借鉴De Loecker（2013）的做法，将农场层面每年的育种与遗传投资纳入生产率的运动方程，以检验这些投资与实际生产率之间的关系。我们独特的数据集还使我们能够考察选用高产奶潜力公牛对生产率的影响。结果表明，提前3年进行的育种投资与当前群体较高的生产率相关。然而，生产率最高的农场从育种投资中获益最少，这表明遗传改良投资存在边际收益递减。当产奶量未经质量调整时，育种对生产率的贡献无法被检测到，这表明育种与牛奶质量投资之间存在关联。我们的结论是，育种与遗传投资显著促进了奶牛场的生产率，尤其是在牛奶质量方面。

title: Agricultural Policy Uncertainty and Its Impact on Commodity Markets
venue: Journal of the Agricultural and Applied Economics Association
abstract: We construct an agricultural policy uncertainty (APU) index from leading national and local newspapers in major agricultural states in the United States from January 1999 to September 2021. Our analysis shows that economic policy uncertainty Granger causes APU linearly in the short run, but the relationship is nonlinear and bidirectional in the long run. When economic policy uncertainty is considered, APU significantly reduces hedgers' net short positions and speculators' net long positions (except for corn hedgers) in the corn and soybean markets. APU also has a significant positive impact on the log returns of corn and soybean futures prices, consistent with the theory of storage where commodity returns and volatility are positively correlated.
abstract_zh: 我们基于1999年1月至2021年9月间美国主要农业州主要全国性和地方性报纸，构建了农业政策不确定性（APU）指数。分析表明，经济政策不确定性在短期内对APU存在线性格兰杰因果关系，但在长期内二者关系是非线性且双向的。在考虑经济政策不确定性的情况下，APU显著降低了套期保值者的净空头头寸和投机者的净多头头寸（玉米套期保值者除外），涉及玉米和大豆市场。APU对玉米和大豆期货价格的对数收益率也有显著的正向影响，这与存货理论一致，即商品收益率与波动率呈正相关。

title: Wholesale Price Dynamics in the Evolving Texas Power Grid
Adoption Patterns and Productivity Impacts of Agricultural Mechanization Services
abstract: Agricultural mechanization services (AMS) have emerged as a viable and effective solution for helping farmers gain access to machinery equipment in developing countries. This study investigates the simultaneous decision‐making regarding multiple mechanization services and the causal impacts of the AMS on land productivity among Chinese smallholders. We find that: (i) The ratio of off‐farm wage to AMS price, or the wage‐rent ratio, has a significant positive effect on AMS adoption; the sequential adoption of AMS starts with power‐intensive followed by control‐intensive production tasks, (ii) Switching to AMS in plowing, transplanting, and harvesting increases rice yield by 48.0 kg, 23.7 kg, and 7.9 kg, respectively, and (iii) The AMS of pesticide spraying significantly decreases yield but the negative effect can be mitigated with professional service providers and effective labor monitoring, highlighting potential moral hazards associated with AMS when monitoring is costly. Simulation illustrates that increased AMS adoption can significantly enhance food security in China.
abstract_zh: 农业机械化服务（AMS）已成为帮助发展中国家农民获得机械设备的一种可行且有效的解决方案。本研究考察了多项机械化服务的同时决策，以及AMS对中国小农户土地生产率的因果影响。我们发现：(i) 非农工资与AMS价格之比，即工资—租金比，对AMS的采用具有显著的正向影响；AMS的采用顺序是先采用动力密集型生产环节，再采用控制密集型生产环节；(ii) 在耕作、插秧和收割环节转向AMS，分别使水稻单产提高48.0千克、23.7千克和7.9千克；(iii) 农药喷洒环节的AMS显著降低了产量，但这种负面影响可以通过专业服务提供者和有效的劳动监督来缓解，这凸显了在监督成本高昂的情况下AMS可能存在的道德风险。模拟结果表明，AMS采用率的提高可以显著增强中国的粮食安全。

title: Transmission Integration and the Market for Congestion Revenue Rights: The Case of the Texas Electricity Market
abstract: Texas electricity market saw a recent integration of electricity transmission as a part of Competitive Renewable Energy Zones (CREZ). Exploiting the commissioning date of CREZ based transmission integration as an exogenous shock, we analyze the effect of transmission expansion on market clearing prices of Congestion Revenue Rights (CRR). Reduced form estimates suggest that excess transmission led to a lowering of CRR prices for contracts at all Times of Use. We find strong evidence of spatial, distributional, and firm specific heterogeneity. The paper shows that transmission expansion enhanced efficiency of the CRR market in terms of a spatial convergence in prices and a decrease in aggregate auction expenditure of approximately $260 million over a period of 4.5 years post CREZ.
abstract_zh: 得克萨斯州电力市场近期将输电整合纳入竞争性可再生能源区（CREZ）的建设之中。我们利用基于CREZ的输电整合投入运行的时间作为外生冲击，分析了输电扩容对拥塞收益权（CRR）市场出清价格的影响。简化式估计表明，过剩的输电容量使所有用电时段的CRR合约价格均有所下降。我们发现了显著的空间、分配及企业层面的异质性证据。本文表明，输电扩容提高了CRR市场的效率，表现为价格的空间趋同，以及在CREZ投运后的4.5年期间，拍卖总支出减少约2.6亿美元。

title: Depressed Demand for Crop Insurance Contracts, and a Rationale Based on Third Generation Prospect Theory
abstract: When actuarially fair insurance for a major risk is available then standard economic theory posits that those subject to the risk should insure. In agriculture, it is common for producers to decline contract offers where presubsidy premiums just cover average losses and subsidies are substantial. This paper seeks to shed light on why demand is curtailed. In a mail survey of U.S. corn and soybean producers we solicited Willingness to Pay (WTP) for actuarially fair insurance at different coverage levels. We find demand to be so low that median WTP is no larger than fair premium when adjusted down by current subsidy rates, which pay for one half or more of most premium charges. WTP as a share of the fair rate is especially low when risk of loss is high. There is limited evidence that respondents appreciate the convex relationship between coverage level and expected indemnity payoff. Third generation Prospect Theory is shown to be consistent with observed findings. In particular, a strong distaste for paying premium can be rationalized by loss aversion. Furthermore, when high revenue outcomes are more likely than not, that is, negative skewness, then higher loss aversion, greater decision weight distortions and greater risk aversion will decrease WTP.
abstract_zh: 当某一重大风险可以获得精算公平的保险时，标准经济理论认为面临该风险的主体应当投保。在农业领域，当补贴前保费仅能覆盖平均损失且补贴金额较大时，生产者拒绝保险合同报价的情况十分常见。本文旨在阐明需求受到抑制的原因。我们通过对美国玉米和大豆生产者进行邮寄调查，询问他们对不同保障水平的精算公平保险的支付意愿（WTP）。我们发现需求极低，以至于经当前补贴率（补贴承担了大多数保费的一半或更多）下调后，中位数支付意愿不超过公平保费。当损失风险较高时，支付意愿占公平费率的比例尤其低。仅有有限证据表明受访者理解保障水平与预期赔付收益之间的凸性关系。第三代前景理论与观察到的结果是一致的。具体而言，对支付保费的强烈反感可以用损失厌恶来解释。此外，当高收入结果更有可能出现（即负偏态）时，更高的损失厌恶、更大的决策权重扭曲以及更强的风险厌恶，都会降低支付意愿。

title: Are Actuarial Crop Insurance Rates Fair?: an Analysis Using a Penalized Bivariate B-Spline Method
venue: Journal of the Royal Statistical Society: Series C (Applied Statistics)
abstract: In this paper, we investigate whether the yield insurance premium rates given by the US Department of Agriculture's Risk Management Agency are actuarially fair by comparing the conditional yield density inferred from premium data with the conditional yield density inferred from yield data. A procedure is developed to estimate the conditional yield density by using premium data through partial derivatives of the premium rate function, as fitted by penalized bivariate tensor product B-splines. We study the asymptotic properties of partial derivatives of a penalized bivariate tensor product B-spline estimator and provide variance estimates. The conditional yield density inferred from premium data and its variance estimator are evaluated through simulation studies. The procedure is also applied to a crop insurance data set from the state of Iowa to examine the actuarial fairness of the premium rates. On average, premium rates are close to our estimates and this is true for each coverage level. However, premiums for low productivity land are generally too low whereas those for high productivity land are generally too high. Even after subsidies, premiums for the more productive land are generally substantially higher than are our estimates of the corresponding actuarially fair rates.
abstract_zh: 本文考察美国农业部风险管理局（RMA）给出的产量保险保费费率是否具有精算公平性，方法是将由保费数据推断的条件产量密度与由产量数据推断的条件产量密度进行比较。我们开发了一套程序，通过对由惩罚二元张量积B样条拟合的保费费率函数求偏导，利用保费数据估计条件产量密度。我们研究了惩罚二元张量积B样条估计量偏导数的渐近性质，并给出了方差估计。通过模拟研究对由保费数据推断的条件产量密度及其方差估计量进行了评估。该程序还被应用于爱荷华州的农业保险数据集，以检验保费费率的精算公平性。总体而言，保费费率与我们的估计值较为接近，且各保障水平下均是如此。然而，低生产力土地的保费普遍偏低，而高生产力土地的保费普遍偏高。即便在补贴之后，生产力较高的土地的保费仍普遍显著高于我们估计的精算公平费率。

title: Evolving Techniques in Production Function Identification Illustrated in the Case of the US Dairy
An Empirical Structural Model of Productivity and Conservation Reserve Program Participation
abstract: The Conservation Reserve Program (CRP), which provides incentives for landowners to idle erodible and marginal farmland, faced new challenges as record-high commodity prices significantly affected landowners’ interests in the program in recent years. We develop and estimate an empirical structural model to examine the manner in which productivity, market conditions, and CRP payment affect landowners’ land use decisions. The model carefully controls for the endogeneity of CRP payment and landowners’ self-selection into the program. The parameter estimates are used to simulate how changes in agricultural prices and CRP payment influence program enrollment and cost across the Corn Belt states. (JEL O13, Q15)
abstract_zh: 保护储备计划（CRP）为土地所有者提供激励，使其闲置易受侵蚀及边际农田。近年来，创纪录的农产品价格显著影响了土地所有者对该计划的兴趣，给该计划带来了新的挑战。我们构建并估计了一个实证结构模型，以考察生产率、市场条件和CRP补贴影响土地所有者土地利用决策的方式。该模型仔细控制了CRP补贴的内生性以及土地所有者的自我选择问题。估计参数被用于模拟农产品价格和CRP补贴的变化如何影响玉米带各州的计划参与率和成本。（JEL O13, Q15）

title: Land Resilience and Tail Dependence Among Crop Yield Distributions
abstract: We propose and empirically test a simple model to shed light on the nature of interactions between weather, land quality, and yield. The conceptual model posits substitution relations between water stress metrics and soil quality, as well as a soil‐conditioned threshold water stress level beyond which soil cannot buffer crop yields. The model implies that yield‐yield dependence should vary as growing conditions vary. In comparison with intermediate growing conditions, yield‐yield dependence should strengthen when growing conditions are either very good or very poor. County yield data strongly support substitution between soil and benign water availability levels, but complementarity between soil and beneficial heat variables. Our estimated model provides qualified support for the hypothesis that better land is more resilient to water stress. We estimate a pseudo‐copula that nests the Gaussian copula, finding strong evidence of left tail dependence among yields. Our formal model and empirical findings corroborate others’ concerns about the appropriateness of current USDA rate‐setting methodologies, which posit constant state‐conditional rank correlations, implicitly assumed by use of the Gaussian copula. An application to aggregate crop yield rate setting suggests that current methods underprice area yield and whole farm premiums. Applying our empirical model to medium‐range weather projections under a climate change scenario for the Northern Great Plains, we infer that systemic yield correlations will increase in future years.
abstract_zh: 我们提出并实证检验了一个简单模型，以阐明天气、土地质量与产量之间相互作用的性质。概念模型假设水分胁迫指标与土壤质量之间存在替代关系，并存在一个由土壤决定的阈值水分胁迫水平，超过该水平后土壤便无法缓冲作物产量。该模型表明，产量之间的依赖关系应随生长条件的变化而变化。与中等生长条件相比，当生长条件非常好或非常差时，产量之间的依赖关系应当增强。县级产量数据有力地支持了土壤与良好水分可利用水平之间的替代关系，但支持土壤与有利热量变量之间的互补关系。我们的估计模型为“较好的土地对水分胁迫更具韧性”这一假设提供了有条件的支持。我们估计了一个嵌套高斯Copula的伪Copula，发现产量之间存在强烈的左尾依赖证据。我们的形式化模型和实证发现，印证了其他学者对当前美国农业部费率设定方法适当性的担忧，这些方法假定了恒定的州条件秩相关，而这隐含地使用了高斯Copula。将本模型应用于总作物产量费率设定的结果表明，现行方法低估了区域产量保险和整体农场保费。将我们的实证模型应用于美国北部大平原气候变化情景下的中期天气预测，我们推断未来年份的系统性产量相关性将会增强。

title: Transition and Integration of the ERCOT Market with the Competitive Renewable Energy Zone Project
abstract: In this study, we seek to explore the impact of a state level transmission expansion project, the Competitive Renewable Energy Zones (CREZ), whose goal is to integrate a massive amount of wind energy, on the wholesale market prices in the Electric Reliability Council of Texas (ERCOT). We find strong evidence for price convergence across ERCOT with accordance to the timing of the expansion of major sections of the CREZ. A variety of empirical analyses shows a gradual transition to a well-integrated market. We also find that regional-specific shocks became more important in terms of driving price change in other regions. Specifically, the impacts of Houston (demand) and the West (wind supply) on each other and the North and South regions have increased significantly. Our study contributes to the literature by connecting the expansion of physical transmission lines with electricity market integration
abstract_zh: 在本研究中，我们旨在探讨州级输电扩容项目——竞争性可再生能源区（CREZ）——对德克萨斯州电力可靠性委员会（ERCOT）批发市场价格的影响。该项目旨在整合大规模风电。我们发现有力证据表明，ERCOT各地区的价格趋同与CREZ主要区段的扩建时间相吻合。多种实证分析表明，市场正在逐步转变为一个高度整合的市场。我们还发现，区域特定的冲击在驱动其他地区价格变动方面变得更加重要。具体而言，休斯顿（需求侧）和西部（风电供给侧）之间的相互影响，以及它们与北部和南部地区之间的相互影响均显著增强。本研究通过将实体输电线路的扩建与电力市场一体化联系起来，对相关文献做出了贡献。

title: Rationality of Choices in Subsidized Crop Insurance Markets
abstract: The U.S. crop insurance market has several features that set it apart from other insurance markets. These include explicit government subsidies with an average premium subsidy rate of about 60% in recent years, and the legislative requirement that premium rates be set at actuarially fair levels, where the federal government sets rates and pays all costs related to insurance policy sales and services. Bearing these features in mind, we examine the extent to which farmers’ crop insurance choices conform to economic theory. A standard expected utility maximization framework is constructed to analyze trade‐offs between higher risk protection and larger subsidy payments. We decompose the effect of coverage level on expected utility into insurance, premium loading, and subsidy transfer effects where the loading effect vanishes if rates are actuarially fair. Given an actuarially fair premium, we infer that a rational farmer should choose either the coverage level with the highest premium subsidy or a higher coverage level. Evidence from a large insurance unit‐level dataset contradicts this theoretical inference, and so suggests anomalous insurance decisions. In a novel application of the mixed logit framework, we show that the probability an insurance product is chosen declines as out‐of‐pocket premium expenditures increase, even though higher values of these expenditures should reflect improved grower welfare. Premium expenditures appear to be more salient than the uncertain future benefits they support. We apply our regression to the recent trend yield adjustment innovation in crop insurance.
abstract_zh: 美国农业保险市场具有若干使其有别于其他保险市场的特征。这些特征包括明确的政府补贴（近年来平均保费补贴率约为60%），以及法律要求保费费率按精算公平水平设定，即由联邦政府设定费率，并承担与保险单销售和服务相关的全部成本。考虑到这些特征，我们考察了农户的农业保险选择在多大程度上符合经济理论。我们构建了标准的期望效用最大化框架，以分析更高风险保障与更大补贴支付之间的权衡。我们将保障水平对期望效用的影响分解为保险效应、保费加载效应和补贴转移效应，其中若费率具有精算公平性，则加载效应消失。在给定精算公平保费的条件下，我们推断理性农户应当选择保费补贴最高的保障水平，或更高的保障水平。来自大型保险单位层面数据集的证据与这一理论推论相矛盾，因此表明存在异常的保险决策。通过对混合Logit框架的新颖应用，我们发现，保险产品被选中的概率随着自付保费支出的增加而下降，尽管这些支出的增加本应反映出生产者福利的改善。保费支出似乎比其所支持的、不确定的未来收益更加显著。我们将回归分析应用于农业保险中近期推出的趋势产量调整创新。

title: Assessing Cost-effectiveness of the Conservation Reserve Program (CRP) and Interactions between the CRP and Crop Insurance
abstract: We examine the U.S. Conservation Reserve Program (CRP) enrollment design while accounting for the CRP’s interactions with the federal crop insurance program. We find that the current CRP is not cost-effective despite its intent to balance benefits and costs. Based on CRP contract-level data, we show that adopting a cost-effective enrollment design and incorporating crop insurance subsidies into the CRP’s Environmental Benefits Index would significantly increase the CRP acreage, environmental benefits, and savings on crop insurance subsidies, while leaving government outlay unchanged. Large geographical redistributions of CRP acreage would also occur. We further investigate the cost-effective design’s robustness to CRP benefit misspecifications. (JEL Q18, Q24)
abstract_zh: 我们考察了美国保护储备计划（CRP）的参与设计，同时考虑了CRP与联邦农业保险计划之间的相互作用。我们发现，尽管现行CRP旨在平衡收益与成本，但其成本效益并不高。基于CRP合同层面的数据，我们表明，采用具有成本效益的参与设计，并将农业保险补贴纳入CRP的环境效益指数，将显著增加CRP的耕地面积、环境效益，以及农业保险补贴的节省，同时保持政府支出不变。CRP耕地的大幅地理再分配也将随之发生。我们进一步考察了该具有成本效益的设计对CRP收益设定误差的稳健性。（JEL Q18, Q24）

title: Responses to Market Information and the Impact on Price Volatility and Trading Volume: The Case of Class III Milk Futures
Geography of Crop Yield Skewness
abstract: Analysis of crop yield distributions provides insights into better understanding how natural resources shape agricultural productivity. This study seeks to provide a rigorous theoretical and empirical understanding of the effects of exogenous geographic and climatic factors on the first three moments of crop yields with focus on the third moment. We hypothesize that exogenous factors having beneficial effects on crop production should make crop yield distributions less positively or more negatively skewed. We employ a large crop insurance data set for corn, soybean, and wheat to find general support for our natural‐resources‐determines‐skewness hypothesis. The proposed statistical method optimally uses correlations between the first three moments. It significantly improves estimation performance over existing methods, including the linear moment model which has been commonly applied in the literature.
abstract_zh: 对作物产量分布的分析，有助于更好地理解自然资源如何塑造农业生产率。本研究旨在对外生地理和气候因素对作物产量前三阶矩的影响，特别是对三阶矩（偏度）的影响，提供严谨的理论与实证理解。我们假设，对作物生产具有有利影响的外生因素，应使作物产量分布的正偏度降低或负偏度增强。我们利用玉米、大豆和小麦的大型农业保险数据集，对“自然资源决定偏度”假设提供了总体支持。所提出的统计方法最优地利用了前三阶矩之间的相关性。与现有方法（包括文献中普遍应用的线性矩模型）相比，该方法显著提高了估计性能。

title: A Natural Resource Theory of U.S. Crop Insurance Contract Choice
abstract: A large variety of subsidized crop insurance products are available to U.S. crop growers. Distinct and perhaps puzzling patterns in the choices of insurance products and coverage levels can be discerned. Where production conditions are better and yields are less risky then (a) higher insurance coverage levels are chosen; and (b) revenue insurance is preferred over yield insurance. Also, (c) the extent of preference for revenue insurance is stronger in more productive areas. Assuming, as many do, that growers seek to maximize subsidy transfers, point (a) can be explained by the interaction between yield technology and natural resource endowments. Points (b) and (c) can be explained by location in conjunction with the “natural hedge” and a contract design bias in how revenue insurance guarantees are computed. Empirical study of Risk Management Agency data on corn, soybean, and wheat yields, and insurance contract choices lend support to our model inferences.
abstract_zh: 美国作物生产者可以选择多种补贴型作物保险产品。我们可以观察到保险产品选择和保障水平方面的一些鲜明而或许令人费解的模式。在生产条件较好、产量风险较低的地区，(a) 农户会选择更高的保险保障水平；(b) 收入保险比产量保险更受青睐。此外，(c) 在生产力较高的地区，对收入保险的偏好更为强烈。若假定农户如许多人所认为的那样，力求最大化补贴转移，则观点(a)可以由产量技术与自然资源禀赋之间的相互作用加以解释。观点(b)和(c)则可以通过“自然对冲”以及收入保险保障计算中的合同设计偏差所导致的区位因素加以解释。基于风险管理局（RMA）关于玉米、大豆和小麦产量及保险合同选择的数据进行的实证研究，支持了我们的模型推断。

Disentangling Corn Price Volatility: the Role of Global Demand, Speculation, and Energy
venue: Journal of Agricultural and Applied Economics
abstract: Despite extensive literature on contributing factors to the high commodity prices and volatility in the recent years, few have examined these causal factors together in one analysis. We quantify empirically the relative importance of three factors: global demand, speculation, and energy prices/policy in explaining corn price volatility. A structural vector auto-regression model is developed and variance decomposition is applied to measure the contribution of each factor in explaining corn price variation. We find that speculation is important, but only in the short run. However, in the long run, energy is the most important followed by global demand.
abstract_zh: 尽管有大量文献探讨了近年来农产品高价格和高波动性的影响因素，但很少有研究将这些因果因素放在同一分析框架中加以考察。我们以实证方式量化了三个因素在解释玉米价格波动中的相对重要性：全球需求、投机以及能源价格与政策。我们构建了结构向量自回归（SVAR）模型，并应用方差分解来衡量每个因素对玉米价格变动的贡献。我们发现，投机只在短期内具有重要作用。然而，从长期来看，能源是最重要的因素，其次是全球需求。

title: Inside the Black Box: the Price Linkage and Transmission between Energy and Agricultural Markets
abstract: Motivated by strong comovement and increasing volatility of energy and agricultural prices, we examine dynamic evolutions of ethanol, gasoline, and corn prices over the period of March 2005-March 2011. A structural change is found around March 2008 in the pairwise dynamic correlations between the prices in a multivariate GARCH model. A structural VAR (SVAR) model is then estimated on two subsamples, one before and one after the identified change point. Using the novel method of identification through heteroscedasticity, we exploit the time-varying price volatilities to fully identify the SVAR model. In the more recent period, ethanol, gasoline, and corn prices are found to be more closely linked with a strengthened corn-ethanol relation, which can be explained by the new developments of the biofuel industry and related policy instruments. Variance decomposition shows that for each market a significant and relatively large share of the price variation could be explained by the price changes in the other two markets. The results are robust to the inclusion of seasonal dummies and various representative macroeconomic and financial indicators.
abstract_zh: 鉴于能源价格与农产品价格之间强烈的联动性和日益上升的波动性，我们考察了2005年3月至2011年3月期间乙醇、汽油和玉米价格的动态演变。在多元GARCH模型中，我们发现两两价格之间的动态相关性在2008年3月前后出现了结构性变化。随后，我们在变化点之前和之后两个子样本上估计了结构向量自回归（SVAR）模型。利用基于异方差的识别这一新颖方法，我们利用时变价格波动率对SVAR模型进行了完全识别。在较近的时期，乙醇、汽油和玉米价格之间的联系更为紧密，玉米—乙醇关系得到加强，这可以由生物燃料产业的新发展及相关政策工具来解释。方差分解表明，对于每个市场而言，其价格变动的很大且相对显著的份额，可以由另外两个市场的价格变化来解释。结果对于纳入季节性虚拟变量以及各种具有代表性的宏观经济和金融指标是稳健的。

title: Testing Day's Conjecture that More Nitrogen Decreases Crop Yield Skewness
abstract: While controversy surrounds skewness attributes of typical yield distributions, a better understanding is important for agricultural policy assessment and for crop‐insurance rate setting. Day (1965) conjectured that crop yield skewness declines with an increase in nitrogen use at low levels but not at higher levels. Employing four corn yield experimental plot datasets, we investigate the conjecture by introducing (a) a flexible Bayesian extension of the Just–Pope technology to incorporate skewness and (b) a quantile‐based measure of skewness shift. Bayesian estimation provides strong evidence in favor of negative skewness at commercial nitrogen rates and for Day's conjecture. There was weaker evidence in favor of positively skewed cotton yield and little evidence in favor of the conjecture. The results are confirmed by the quantile‐based measure. We also find evidence that skewness becomes more negative upon moving from corn‐after‐corn to corn‐after‐soybean.
abstract_zh: 尽管关于典型产量分布的偏度特征存在争议，但更好地理解这一问题对于农业政策评估和作物保险费率设定都非常重要。Day（1965）推测，在低水平施氮时，作物产量偏度随氮肥施用量的增加而下降，而在较高水平施氮时则不会。我们利用四个玉米产量的田间试验数据集，通过引入(a)一个灵活的Just–Pope技术贝叶斯扩展模型以纳入偏度，以及(b)一个基于分位数的偏度变化度量，对该推测进行了检验。贝叶斯估计为商业施氮水平下的负偏度，以及Day的推测提供了有力证据。对于棉花产量呈正偏的证据较弱，而支持该推测的证据则很少。基于分位数的度量也证实了这些结果。我们还发现，从玉米连作转为玉米—大豆轮作时，偏度会变得更为负值。

title: The Effects of Potential Changes in United States Beef Production on Global Grazing Systems and Greenhouse Gas Emissions
abstract: We couple a global agricultural production and trade model with a greenhouse gas model to assess leakage associated with modified beef production in the United States. The effects on emissions from agricultural production (i.e., methane and nitrous oxide emissions from livestock and crop management) as well as from land-use change, especially grazing system, are assessed. We find that a reduction of US beef production induces net carbon emissions from global land-use change ranging from 37 to 85 kg CO 2 -equivalent per kg of beef annualized over 20 years. The increase in emissions is caused by an inelastic domestic demand as well as more land-intensive cattle production systems internationally. Changes in livestock production systems such as increasing stocking rate could partially offset emission increases from pasture expansion. In addition, net emissions from enteric fermentation increase because methane emissions per kilogram of beef tend to be higher globally.
abstract_zh: 我们将全球农业生产与贸易模型和温室气体模型相耦合，以评估美国牛肉生产方式改变所带来的碳泄漏问题。我们考察了农业生产（即畜牧和作物管理中产生的甲烷和一氧化二氮排放）以及土地利用变化（尤其是放牧系统）对排放的影响。我们发现，美国牛肉产量的减少会引发全球土地利用变化导致的净碳排放，按20年年化计算，每千克牛肉的排放量为37至85千克二氧化碳当量。排放增加的原因在于国内需求缺乏弹性，以及国际上更为依赖土地的养牛生产系统。提高载畜率等畜牧生产系统的变化，可以部分抵消牧场扩张所带来的排放增加。此外，由于全球范围内每千克牛肉的甲烷排放量往往更高，肠道发酵产生的净排放也随之增加。

Does a Rising Biofuels Tide Raise All Boats? A Study of Cash Rent Determinants for Iowa Farmland under Hay and Pasture
venue: Journal of Agricultural & Food Industrial Organization
abstract: Iowa's farmland consists of over 16% hay crops and pastureland, a significant portion of which is under cash rental contracts. This study investigates the comparative relationships between cash rental rates for cropped land and non-cropped land, where the latter includes hay and pastureland. We find that higher crop prices resulting from biofuel demand induces land use conversion from non-cropped land to crop production and thus bids up non-cropped land rents. Compared with changes in cropped land cash rents, non-cropped farmland rents could increase by a higher percentage. Non-cropped land cash rental rates are largely determined by crop and feeder cattle prices, population density, soil quality, and proportion of non-cropped land in a specific area. A primary effect of ethanol subsidies is the redistribution of income between corn growers and livestock producers, whereby higher livestock feed costs together with increasing hay and pastureland cash rents harm the dairy and feedlot beef sectors. Our study shows that, because of the positive effect on rents, the policies have an indeterminate effect on landowners operating in the cow-calf sector.
abstract_zh: 爱荷华州的农田中，超过16%为干草作物和牧场，其中相当大一部分处于现金租赁合同之下。本研究考察了耕地与非耕地现金租金率之间的比较关系，其中非耕地包括干草地和牧场。我们发现，生物燃料需求带来的作物价格上涨，会促使非耕地转为作物生产，从而推高非耕地租金。与耕地现金租金的变化相比，非耕地农田租金的上涨幅度可能更大。非耕地现金租赁率主要由作物价格和育肥牛（feeder cattle）价格、人口密度、土壤质量以及特定地区非耕地所占比例决定。乙醇补贴的主要效应是在玉米种植者与畜牧生产者之间进行收入再分配，其中饲料成本上升，连同干草和牧场现金租金的上涨，损害了乳制品和饲养场肉牛部门。我们的研究表明，由于对租金具有正向效应，这些政策对于经营牛犊—母牛生产环节的土地所有者的影响是不确定的。
